author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅವನಿಯಲಿ ಮೊದಲಗುರು ಹೆತ್ತವಳೆ ಆಗುವಳು
ನವಕುಸುಮವರಳುದಕೆ ಬೆಂಬಲದ ಶಕ್ತಿ
ಸವೆಯುತಿಹ ಜೀವನಕೆ ಹೊಸಕಳೆಯ ತುಂಬಿಸಲು
ಅವತರಿಪ ಅರಿವೆ ಗುರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: On this earth, the first guru is the mother who bore us;
the strength that supports the new flower to bloom;
to fill a wearing life with fresh radiance,
the guru is knowledge itself descending, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Also for Guru Pūrṇimā. Our mother is our first teacher, the support that lets a young life bloom. The guru is knowledge itself, coming down to renew a tired life.
